# Fabricated native fixtures

All native fixture records are constructed in `tests/native.rs` and `native/usage.rs` tests. They contain only fabricated identifiers, `/fabricated` or `/synthetic` project paths, fixed timestamps, and explicit test bodies. No local provider home, transcript, prompt, credential, or provider executable is read. SQLite writers run in a separate Python process to reproduce the provider/process boundary; the reader itself uses bundled SQLite and never invokes Python.

| --- | --- | --- |

## Serialization contracts

`native_serialized_contracts_from_fabricated_stores` writes only when `UPDATE_NATIVE_CONTRACTS=1` is explicitly set. Ordinary tests compare checked-in bytes. Only run-derived node/span/snapshot IDs, source-revision IDs and temporary canonical store namespaces are normalized. Native message identities, original locators, exact values, unknown values, roles, and timestamps remain unchanged.

- `native-pi-overview.json` and `native-pi-detail.json` come from a real fabricated JSONL reader.
- `native-auxiliary-overview.json` and `native-auxiliary-detail.json` come from a real Pi reader with standalone, compaction and branch-summary contributions (30 tokens, three contributors, zero generations).
- `native-sqlite-detail.json` and `native-sqlite-tool-detail.json` come from a real fabricated WAL database reader.
- `native-provenance-variants.json` serializes the typed locator domain, including optional ranges, exact large offsets, plain JSON pointers, and SQLite text/integer/blob keys with column/JSON/absent fields.
- `native-usage-variants.json` serializes contribution, reconciliation, inherited and breakdown roles, all exact-counter states, large values, and normalization explanations. These enum-shape fixtures are serialization evidence; numerical behavior is separately tested through actual readers and accounting tests.

The existing collector contract files remain separate and are not rewritten to accommodate native support.
